## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D, wave D3. Owner request of 14 Nov 2026 after comparing the Azure dev app with the approved designs.

Persona and route: Every screen of web/clinic and web/platform-admin · all staff roles.
Findings: Measured 14 Nov 2026. The audit's own workspace concept draws controls at 36 px, rows at 40 px and text at 14 px with a mouse, and switches to 44 px controls and 48 px rows only on a coarse pointer (any-pointer: coarse, or its Touch sizing switch). The design files agree (Medvya Web .btn.sm 36 px used 92 times, view switches 32 px, tabs as text with an underline). The code applied 44 px to every control on every device (DESIGN.md ruling 2, MDV-P1-077, MDV-P1-078), and registration lays fields out two per row where the design fits five. The owner finds the app much bigger than the design.
Rationale: The approved design is compact with a mouse and comfortable on touch. WCAG 2.2 target size (2.5.8) needs 24 px; 36 px with a mouse meets it with room. Touch keeps 44 px and 48 px rows, so the tablet and phone experience does not change.
Proposed UX behaviour: The control token is 36 px and the row token 40 px by default, and 44 px and 48 px under any-pointer: coarse, exactly as the concept. Library controls (Button, Input, Select, Textarea, SegmentedControl, Tabs, ChoiceRow, dropdown items, table rows) read the tokens instead of hard-coded 44 px; Button sm is 30 px with a mouse. Base text is 14 px; the page header description uses the body size. Tabs are text with a 2 px underline, not filled boxes. Registration: fields auto-fit at a 200 px minimum, steps are a vertical list from 1024 px, the hint sits under the control. AGENTS.md section 4 and DESIGN.md ruling 2 are amended in the same change to say 44 px on touch, 36 px with a mouse, never under 24 px.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/medvya-workspace-concept.html; docs/product-ux-audit/08-design-system-blueprint.md section 4 (Density).
Components and tokens affected: --spacing-control, row token, type tokens, Button, Input, Select, Textarea, SegmentedControl, Tabs, ChoiceRow, Table, Field, PageHeader.
Front end and back end split: Front end only.
Prerequisites and blocked by: None beyond the library tickets, which are merged.
Clinical sign-off: Not required: no wording, order or safety state changes; the allergy still shows in words.
Effort and regression risk: M · Medium: visible on every screen; size checks in end-to-end tests change with the rule.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) A user setting for density. (2) Palette or typeface changes. (3) Mobile apps (mobile/), which keep their own sizes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a mouse (fine pointer) at 1440 by 900, when any clinic screen renders, then buttons, inputs, selects and view switches are 36 px tall and table rows 40 px
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a coarse pointer (touch emulation), when the same screens render, then controls are at least 44 px and rows 48 px
- [ ] **AC3.** Given every page, when the text is measured, then body text is 14 px
- [ ] **AC4.** Given the patient record and settings tabs, when they render, then the selected tab is shown by an underline and weight and exposed to assistive technology
- [ ] **AC5.** Given registration at 1440 px, when the Identity step opens, then at least four fields share a row and the last field is above the fold
- [ ] **AC6.** Given AGENTS.md section 4 and DESIGN.md, when read, then they state 36 px with a mouse, 44 px on touch and never under 24 px
- [ ] **AC7.** Given English and Arabic, when axe runs (including target-size), then there is no violation

## Test notes

- packages/ui controls tests read the tokens; tests/e2e size checks use a shared helper that expects 36 px with a mouse and 44 px under touch emulation; one coarse-pointer project or test per area.

## Notes / open questions

- Regression risk: medium.
